subproblem.title: Currents given by L¹ densities on unit faces: integrability of the integrands, existence (linearity and sequential continuity), and the mass bound M ≤ Σ∫|w_F| (Simon Ch. 6, (29), (34); step 6 of the parent proof)
subproblem.statement: Conventions (as in the selected node): ℝ^P = Euclid P, ℝⁿ = Euclid n, Hᵈ = μHE[d], e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 ∈ ℝ^P, x_i the i-th coordinate. n := m + 1. For a pair p = (z, ι) ∈ ℤ^P × (Fin n → Fin P): Φ_p(y) := z + Σ_{j<n} y_j e_{ι(j)} for y ∈ ℝⁿ (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)); e_p := (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}); Q₁ := {y ∈ ℝⁿ : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i} with Lebesgue measure (volume); F_p := {x ∈ ℝ^P : z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for i ∈ range ι, x_i = z_i for i ∉ range ι} (the closed unit face of the selected node's statement); A_p := Φ_p(Q₁) (the open face). 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d (domain univ throughout); ∂X = X.boundary; M_W(X) = X.massOn W and M(X) = X.mass (Euclidean coefficient norm covectorEuclideanNorm); IMRep and IsIntegerMultiplicity are the contract notions. Statement: let P, m ∈ ℕ, s a finite set of pairs p = (z, ι) with every ι strictly increasing, and w_p : ℝⁿ → ℝ (p a pair) with w_p integrable on Q₁ for every p ∈ s. Then (I) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) and p ∈ s, y ↦ w_p(y)·ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) is integrable on Q₁; (II) there is D ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with D(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} w_p(y)·ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) dy for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P); (III) every D ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) satisfying this formula has M(D) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁}|w_p|).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P))) (w : (Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.2) → (∀ p ∈ s, IntegrableOn (w p) {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), ∀ p ∈ s, IntegrableOn (fun y => w p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ))) {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) ∧ (∃ D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), D ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, w p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ))) ∧ ∀ D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), D ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, w p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ))) → D.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |w p y|)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: Simon Ch. 6, proof of 5.1, (29) and the mass estimate in (34) via 2.35, as used in step 6 of the parent proof ("Pc is linear and |Pc(ω)| ≤ (Σ|β_p|)·sup|ω(e_ι)|, so it is sequentially continuous on test forms"; "M(Q − Pc) ≤ Σ∫|θ_p − β_p|"), stated for general L¹ densities w_p.

1. Pointwise bounds. Let ω be a test n-form. It is continuous with compact support, so ‖ω‖_∞ := sup_x ‖ω(x)‖ < ∞ (operator norm of continuous alternating maps). For every x and p ∈ s, |ω(x)(e_p)| ≤ ‖ω(x)‖·∏_k ‖e_{ι(k)}‖ = ‖ω(x)‖ ≤ ‖ω‖_∞. Moreover, since ι is strictly increasing and basisFun i = e_i (EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply), ω(x)(e_p) is the term indexed by I = ι in covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) = (Σ_{I : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing} ω(x)(basisFun∘I)²)^{1/2}; hence |ω(x)(e_p)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)).

2. (I). For p ∈ s, y ↦ ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) is continuous (Φ_p is affine, hence continuous; ω is continuous; evaluation at the fixed tuple e_p is continuous), hence AE-strongly measurable, and it is bounded by ‖ω‖_∞ (step 1). Since w_p is integrable on Q₁, the product y ↦ w_p(y)·ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) is integrable on Q₁ (Integrable.bdd_mul / Integrable.mul_bdd).

3. (II). For ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) let L(ω) := Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} w_p(y) ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) dy. Because (ω + ω')(x)(v) = ω(x)(v) + ω'(x)(v) and (cω)(x)(v) = c·ω(x)(v), (I) and linearity of the integral (integral_add, integral_smul) show that L is linear. Sequential continuity: let ω_j → 0 in the sense of TestFormOnConverges ω_j 0. Then there is a compact K with tsupport ω_j ⊆ K for all j, and iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 ω_j → 0 uniformly on K; since ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 f x‖ = ‖f(x)‖ and ω_j = 0 off K, ε_j := sup_x ‖ω_j(x)‖ → 0. By step 1, |L(ω_j)| ≤ Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} |w_p(y)|·ε_j dy = ε_j·Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁}|w_p| → 0. Hence L is a continuous current in the sense of GeometricCurrentOn univ n; this is the required D.

4. (III). Let D ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) satisfy the formula and let ω be admissible for M(D) = M_{ℝ^P}(D), i.e. covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x. By step 1, |ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p)| ≤ 1 for all y and p ∈ s, so by (I) and integral_mono, D(ω) ≤ Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} |w_p(y)|·|ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p)| dy ≤ Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁}|w_p|. Hence ofReal(D(ω)) ≤ ofReal(Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁}|w_p|) for every admissible ω, and taking the supremum (sSup_le) gives M(D) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁}|w_p|). ∎
proof_key_steps: |ω(x)(e_p)| ≤ ‖ω(x)‖ ≤ ‖ω‖_∞, and |ω(x)(e_p)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) since e_p is a strictly increasing coordinate frame.
Integrable × bounded continuous is integrable on Q₁.
The formula is linear and bounded by (Σ∫|w_p|)·sup|ω|, hence sequentially continuous on test forms: it defines a current.
Admissible forms satisfy |ω(e_p)| ≤ 1, so M(D) ≤ ofReal(Σ_p ∫_{Q₁}|w_p|).

audit.reason: Bounded continuous evaluation factors prove integrability and linearity. Uniform convergence of zeroth derivatives on the common compact support proves the contract's sequential continuity.
